description: Promotes commercial oil palm plantation across designated foothills and valley regions to boost edible oil production and diversify traditional shifting (jhum) cultivation.
benefits: 100% subsidy on high-yielding oil palm planting material (saplings), inter-cropping assistance of ₹5,200 per hectare, and maintenance allowance over 4 years.
eligibility: Farmers owning or holding community land rights in notified oil palm districts of Manipur
Registration on the State Horticulture & Agriculture Portal is required
documents: Land Ownership Certificate / Tribal Village Chief Land Authorization
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture / Agriculture Officer or Online Portal

scheme_name: Mission Organic Value Chain Development for North Eastern Region (MOVCDNER-Manipur)
description: Focuses on developing certified organic crop clusters for niche regional crops like Black Rice (Chak-Hao), Kachai Lemon, Sirarakhong Chili, and Ginger.
benefits: Financial grant of ₹45,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic inputs, quality planting material, free Third-Party PGS/NPOP organic certification, and value-addition infrastructure.
eligibility: Farmer Producer Companies (FPCs), Farmer Interest Groups (FIGs), and individual growers operating in certified organic clusters in Manipur
documents: Land Document or Village Authority Certificate
application_mode: Offline through District Agriculture / MOMA (Manipur Organic Mission Agency) Offices

scheme_name: Manipur Horticulture Development Scheme (Protected Cultivation & Polyhouse)
description: Supports construction of tubular polyhouses, shade nets, and anti-hail nets for off-season vegetable farming and floriculture (orchids, gerbera) in hill and valley districts.
benefits: 50% to 75% capital subsidy for polyhouse and shade net construction, plus subsidized micro-irrigation kits.
eligibility: Horticulture growers, smallholders, and self-help groups in Manipur with suitable land access
documents: Land Record Extract or Village Chief Land Allotment Letter
application_mode: Offline via District Officer (Horticulture & Soil Conservation)

description: Provides financial subsidies on small farm machinery designed for terrace, valley, and hilly terrains, including power tillers, brush cutters, paddy reapers, and mini-tractors.
benefits: 50% to 80% subsidy for SC/ST/Women/Small farmers on individual tools and up to 80% subsidy for setting up Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) by SHGs.
eligibility: Farmers owning or operating agricultural land in Manipur, registered SHGs, and cooperatives
documents: Land Ownership Certificate / Village Authority Verification
application_mode: Online via Agmachinery Portal / Offline via District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Pukhri / Community Water Tank Construction Scheme (Jal Shakti Convergence)
description: Supports excavation of individual farm ponds (Pukhri) and water storage tanks in hilly and valley areas to ensure life-saving irrigation for winter crops.
benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹1,50,000 for excavating lined farm ponds and water collection structures under MGNREGA and Agriculture convergence.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers holding cultivable land in Manipur
documents: Land Ownership Document or Village Chief Certificate
application_mode: Offline via Gram Panchayat / Village Authority / Agriculture Officer

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Backyard Poultry & Piggery Mission
description: Encourages rural households and tribal farmers to adopt scientific backyard piggery and poultry rearing to boost meat self-sufficiency and farm income.
benefits: 50% to 75% subsidy on purchasing piglets/day-old chicks, high-protein feed, night shelters, and free animal vaccination coverage.
eligibility: Permanent residents of Manipur, priority given to SC/ST households, BPL families, and Women SHGs
application_mode: Offline via Veterinary & Animal Husbandry Department / District Offices

scheme_name: Integrated Oak Tasar & Mulberry Sericulture Scheme
description: Leverages Manipur's unique agro-climate for Oak Tasar, Mulberry, and Eri silk production by subsidizing rearing equipment, food-plant plantations, and rearing sheds.
benefits: Financial grant up to ₹1,20,000 for silkworm rearing shed construction, free supply of Oak Tasar / Mulberry saplings, and subsidized silkworm dfts/seeds.
eligibility: Traditional silk rearers, farm women, and tribal households in Manipur with land for host plants
documents: Land Availability Proof / Village Authority Certificate
application_mode: Offline via District Sericulture Officer / Directorate of Sericulture Manipur

scheme_name: Manipur Inland & Cage Aquaculture Promotion Scheme
description: Promotes inland fish culture in ponds, circular tanks (Biofloc), and floating cage culture in major lakes/reservoirs (e.g., Loktak Lake) to meet high local fish demand.
benefits: 40% subsidy for General and 60% for SC/ST/Women on constructing new fish ponds, fingerlings, fish feed, and cage unit setups.
eligibility: Fishermen, fish farmers, and unemployed youth in Manipur with access to land or water bodies
application_mode: Offline via District Fisheries Officer or Online State Fisheries Portal

scheme_name: PM-KUSUM Solar Irrigation Scheme - Manipur Component
description: Installs standalone solar-powered water pumping systems in off-grid and hilly agricultural regions where grid electricity access is limited.
benefits: Up to 80% combined central and state financial subsidy on standalone solar pumpsets (2 HP to 5 HP capacity).
eligibility: Farmers owning cultivable land in Manipur with an active water source (stream, pond, well) lacking electricity
documents: Self-Declaration of No Grid Power at Pumping Site
application_mode: Offline via MANIREDA (Manipur Renewable Energy Development Agency) / District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Soil Health Card & Soil Conservation Scheme
description: Provides free soil testing and custom nutrient advice, along with terrace land development and contour bunding subsidies to check soil erosion on hill slopes.
benefits: Free Soil Health Card issued every 2 years, plus 80% subsidy for bench terracing and contour bunding construction on hill slopes.
eligibility: All farmers practicing hill or valley agriculture in Manipur
documents: Land Record / Village Authority Land Identity
application_mode: Offline via District Soil Conservation / Agriculture Extension Center
